notes: Inbound only in these files: index.js:46 registers the PaymentService charge handler. The only outgoing client call is the flagd flag lookup (charge.js:9, charge.js:19-20).
No messages published or consumed, and no Kafka client, in src/paymentservice/index.js, charge.js, opentelemetry.js or package.json (package.json:14-35).
No registry, discovery or coordinator is referenced in these files. docker-compose.yml:446-450 depends_on (otelcol, flagd) sets start order only and is not a call edge.
No heartbeat in these files. A gRPC health service is served at index.js:42-44 (health.service, status SERVING at index.js:43); the status is static and not on a timer.
No health check: the paymentservice block docker-compose.yml:423-451 has no healthcheck key, and src/paymentservice/Dockerfile:1-26 has no HEALTHCHECK instruction.
Telemetry interval not stated: opentelemetry.js:25-27 PeriodicExportingMetricReader sets no export interval, and opentelemetry.js:16 sets no batch settings; library default, not in these files.

flagd protocol and host binding are not stated in these files: charge.js:9 constructs FlagdProvider with no arguments. FLAGD_HOST and FLAGD_PORT are passed through at docker-compose.yml:440-441 (values .env:129-130). How the provider reads them is library default, not in these files.

Container name differs from the compose key: docker-compose.yml:423 key paymentservice, docker-compose.yml:425 container_name payment-service. OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=paymentservice at docker-compose.yml:445.

Posture override: modules/otel-demo/deployment/compose.candidate-postures.yml:96 replaces the entrypoint, so with OTEL_PLACEMENT_ENABLED equal to false the process runs node index.js without --require ./opentelemetry.js. The telemetry facts apply only to the instrumented launch.

syncEdges.note: Flag evaluation call site (charge.js:19 setProviderAndWait). Callee host and port come from the environment (docker-compose.yml:440-441, .env:129-130). Protocol is not stated in these files.

replicas.note: library default, not in these files: no replicas key in the paymentservice block docker-compose.yml:423-451 (its deploy block at lines 431-434 sets only a memory limit)

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Host resolved from .env:27. The endpoint is set by docker-compose.yml:442 (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT) and .env:32, port 4317 from .env:28.
